method: Rarible token ids carry the creator address in the top 160 bits. For each contract below: the explorer token lists (Etherscan v2, tokennfttx or token1155tx filtered by contract) for the three collector wallets, both artist addresses and the royalty wallet; balanceOf(wallet) on the ERC-721s; and balanceOfBatch on the ERC-1155s for every id (artist address << 96 | n, n = 0 to 1000) under both artist addresses, for each collector wallet. The contracts are Rarible's shared contracts on Ethereum and Polygon plus the Ethereum RARI contract the artist's posts link to. Rarible's own API (items by creator), which would list lazy-minted items that never reached the chain, now requires a key and was not read.

notes: No collector wallet has ever received or sent a token on any of the five contracts, and every balance is zero.
The artist's only on-chain Rarible token is on the Polygon ERC-721: minted to 0x9410... on 2022-04-30 00:08 UTC and burned six minutes later (artistTokensOnChain).

No transfer on the Ethereum contracts involves an artist address, so the Rari Masks and the canvas-is-everywhere tokens were, as far as the chain shows, lazy-minted listings: signed on Rarible and minted only if bought. This scan does not establish whether another buyer ever minted one, because a lazy mint may go straight to the buyer.
